lines: HDFC’s Executive Committee serves as the leadership body guiding the Housing Development and Finance Committee’s strategic direction and governance. The committee hosts hybrid meetings, with in–person and remote options to attend. Both options have opportunities for public comment.
Note: All meeting times and locations are subject to change.
No future meetings in this filter.
If you need assistance, including accessibility accommodations, please contact HDFC’s Executive Committee Administrator no later than five calendar days before the meeting:
